libraryIntro: Choose and manage the Bible versions you want to use. Versions may be downloaded for offline use or added from online sources.
offlineNotice: You are offline. Downloaded versions are ready to read; online versions need an internet connection.
guestNotice: Sign in to browse, add, and read online Bible versions. Downloaded versions remain available without an account.
catalogError: Some versions could not be loaded. You can still use your saved versions.
emptyLibrary: Add a Bible version to start your library.
noVersions: No versions are available here right now.
offlineDescription: Add and download an offline version to your library to read it without an internet connection.
onlineDescription: Add an online version to your library to read it without downloading the full Bible. Sign-in and an internet connection are required to read. Your highlights and notes remain available across versions.
includedVersion: This version is included with the app.
infoLibrary: Keep the translations you use in My Bible Versions. Downloaded versions work offline, and online versions stream text while you are signed in. Adding a version saves it to your library; select Read this version to use it in the reader.
infoTranslations: Different translations use different wording to convey the original text. Choose the version that helps you understand it best. Your highlights and notes stay connected to their Scripture references.
unavailableDescription: This translation is no longer in the catalog. Go back to choose another version.
offlineReadNotice: You are offline. Connect to the internet to read this version.
offlineDownloadNotice: Connect to the internet to download this version.
highlightsDescription: Highlight verses and add notes as you read.
chapterUnavailable: This chapter is unavailable in this translation.
loadError: Unable to load this Bible version. Please try again.
actionError: Unable to complete this action. Please try again.
onlineOnlyError: This translation is available for online reading only.
signInError: Sign in to use online Bible versions.
removalInProgressError: This version is being removed. Please try again.
downloadInProgressError: Wait for this version to finish downloading before removing it.
missingFileError: {{version}} is missing from device storage. Please download it again.
downloadError: Unable to download this version. Please try again.
providerBusyError: {{provider}} is busy. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
providerConnectionError: Unable to connect to {{provider}}. Please try again.
providerResponseError: Unable to read the content returned by {{provider}}. Please try again.
